characters.name: The Soldier
characters.description: The standard company — a mercenary line backed by archers, marching under the Idol of Mars.

characters.name: The Priest
characters.description: Trades an archer for a healer and carries the Idol of Minerva. Shuns the shaman's craft; mages seldom answer the call.

characters.name: The Gambler
characters.description: Two mercenaries traded for a ronin and a rogue, with the Idol of Janus. Rogues flock to the table.
